messages:
Aisha (CSM): Heads-up: Orchard Labs renewal ~6w. Platform telemetry shows a steady 55% drop in embed API calls over last 28d. New PM (Maya) onboarded 10 days ago per notes. Could be competitive pilot.
Ben (AE): I pinged Maya last Thurs. She said they're trialing LexiAI for nightly batch embeds to cut costs. Wanted a numbers comparison (cost / 95th latency) and the ability to burst for their 2am pipeline.
Tom (Solutions): Pulled their usage histogram. Their nightly job spikes to ~1200 concurrent embed requests, avg seq length ~2.1k tokens. Our dedicated pool p95 for that shape is ~480ms; p99 ~820ms. Cost estimate for current window at standard quant is $2.6k/mo.
Aisha (CSM): Two quick actions: (1) Ben please lock a 30m QBR this week with Maya + procurement; (2) Tom can you produce a 1-pager with: p95/p99, cost at three quant profiles (fp16/4-bit/8-bit) and a recommended short-term burst config.
Ben (AE): Scheduling now. Proposing Wed 11am PT. Maya available. Sending invite with our pricing summary.
Tom (Solutions): One-pager draft will include: sample k8s-like burst config, expected cost delta, and a table showing tradeoffs for prefix/KV cache hits vs full re-embed. Also adding a note on tokenization inefficiencies (some of their docs tokenize poorly -> extra cost).
Aisha (CSM): Good call on tokenization. Can we ask them to share a small sample of their most-used docs before the QBR so we can quantify token-savings from deduping/trim?
Ben (AE): I'll request a redacted sample in the invite.
deply-bot: Reminder set: ORCH-REN-170245; follow-up in 72h; owner=Aisha (CSM).
Aisha (CSM): New play: offer a 4-week dedicated-burst trial scoped to the nightly pipeline and capped at a fixed token budget. Measure cost-per-embed and latency; if we can match LexiAI cost or show better reliability, use as renewal leverage.
Tom (Solutions): I'll include a recommended autoscale policy (min nodes 2, burst up to 8 for 3h nightly) and an estimated cost table for three quantization profiles plus caching. Also will call out limitations: if they require model export or on-prem deployment, we should route to Private sales.
Ben (AE): Invite sent and accepted. Procurement contact cc'd. Maya asked if we can provide a short runbook to validate correctness of embeddings vs LexiAI (similarity threshold + small eval set).
Aisha (CSM): We'll prepare a tiny eval harness (20 sample queries) to compare embedding quality and latency. Tom, can you add expected token counts for that harness so procurement sees cost of evaluating?
Tom (Solutions): Yep — will attach numbers and a suggested eval template.
Aisha (CSM): After the QBR we'll reconvene here with outcome and next steps (convert to renewal play or escalate to execs). Tagging as renewal-risk: elevated. :warning:
Ben (AE): Noted.
Tom (Solutions): thumbs up :thumbsup:
